title: What Is Happening and What Relates to What: A Common-Person Relational Guide to the Hodge Conjecture and the Rosetta Patterns
description: This guide provides a warm, complete, and step-by-step relational explanation of our mathematical research on the Hodge Conjecture for Calabi-Yau four-folds and its connection to the other Millennium problems. We explain in simple everyday language what the Hodge Conjecture is asking, how the seventy-dimensional shape space splits fifty-fifty into two thirty-five-dimensional chiral halves, how pressing a mathematical tare button removes the ordinary symmetric shapes of sizes sixteen and four hundred thirty-two to reveal the hidden eleven hundred fifty-two core at an exact ninety-degree right angle, and how every formal Lean 4 theorem module connects to the next like links in a chain. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
